derivation: Work order 022, part 2: 'derive a ceiling per order from the collectors' prices for the same items, so turning in an order never pays far more than selling the goods.' (1) The collectors' rate. Every Rustmoor collector price is set by one formula, content/tuning/economy-rustmoor.json anchors.end_product_price: 'collector_price = labour-seconds of the whole chain x 15/108', 15/108 Crowns per labour-second, 500 Crowns per hour of labour (anchors.market_rate); Brass Key 216 s = 30, Iron Lock 378 s = 53, Garnet Sight 972 s = 135, and the salvage prices (anchors.scavenging_salvage) Bent Nails 8, Umbrella Ribs 15, Odd Spoons 23, Clock Movement 30. (2) Valuing an order's goods. An item with a collector_price is valued at that price. An item with none (Copper, Brass Ingot, Iron Ore, Iron Ingot, Coal, Steel Ingot, Garnet, Rustmoor Ration) is valued by the same formula the collectors use, its whole chain's labour-seconds x 15/108: Copper 54 s = 7.5, Brass Ingot 108 s = 15 (the market_rate anchor itself), Iron Ore 108 s = 15, Iron Ingot 216 s = 30, Coal 162 s = 22.5, Steel Ingot 540 s = 75, Garnet 216 s = 30; a Rustmoor Ration is one Ration per 54 s at every Cooking tier (anchors.cooking_recipes), 54 s = 7.5, plus the 2 Crowns of grocer ingredients it costs at every tier, 9.5. (3) Order size. Each order is about 1 to 2 hours of the Boiler's work at its band minimum (work order 022, part 2); the pool is sized at 1.46 to 1.62 hours. (4) The Crown share, proposal: an order pays half its goods' value in Crowns, rounded half up, and the other half is the Favour. Reason: work order 019 priced a story Favour point in goods, 20 Brass Ingots, 20 Rations or 14 Coal (GDD appendix A.2), and 20 Brass Ingots are 2160 labour-seconds, 300 Crowns at the collectors' rate; at half, the goods an order keeps for its Favour are worth 366 to 425 Crowns, close to that price, and the Crowns paid are always below what the goods would fetch at the collectors' rate. (5) Ceiling: the largest order, 2 hours of labour, is worth 2 x 500 = 1000 Crowns at the collectors' rate; half is 500. The ceiling is 500 Crowns per order. The pool pays 366 to 425. Rat Scrap is not asked for: it is a free by-product of every fight, so an order for it was free Favour; the Gaugers' band 5 to 9 order asks 50 Umbrella Ribs instead (work order 022, 'Settled after review'), 50 x 108 s = 5400 s = 1.5 hours at Scavenging 5, valued 50 x 15 = 750, paying 375. (6) Faucet: one order every 8 hours is 21 a week; at the pool's mean of 386.75 Crowns (6188 over 16 orders) that is 8122 Crowns a week (8121.75, rounded), 15.8% of the 51,313 Crowns a week the drops check reports for Rustmoor (kills 42,336 + collectors 8,977); at the ceiling, 21 x 500 = 10,500, 20.5%.
